_comment: Toolchain pin for the layout/ verification flow (klt drc / klt extract /
klt lvs), checked (not merely recorded) before either runner does
anything -- the layout/ analogue of sim/toolchain.json's ngspice/PDK pin.
Why this is a CAPABILITY list, not a version number: `klt --version`
reports a static '0.1.0' from klayout-tools' own pyproject.toml, which
does not change commit-to-commit (no dynamic/scm versioning upstream as
of this pin) -- confirmed directly while implementing issue #51: a git
install at commit e08f24f (2026-08-01, includes both `extract` and
`lvs`) still reports 'klt 0.1.0', identical to the release issue #15
pinned against that had neither verb. A version string comparison would
therefore silently pass against a `klt` that is missing a verb this repo
needs. `klt_required_commands` is the actual drift-detectable pin: both
runners probe `klt <command> --help` for each entry and fail loudly,
with the install command in the error text, if one is missing --
exercised directly by running this bring-up against the release issue
#15 pinned (`klt 0.1.0`, no `extract`/`lvs`) before upgrading.
Why `klt_install` names an exact commit and not a floating `git+URL`
(unlike issue #15's own `layout/README.md`, which installs from
`main` with no ref): verified directly while implementing #51 that
`main` is not safe to float against here. Upstream commit `1d5fc60`
(PR #192, merged after `lvs` landed at `e08f24f` but before this pin
was cut) adds gf180mcu DRC coverage for the MiM capacitor stack and
Metal2-5/MetalTop -- exactly the layers `layout/drc/cells/
uncovered_layer_probe.gds` (issue #15's negative control) draws on to
prove the deck's *lack* of coverage there. Installing anything at or
after `1d5fc60` makes `layout/drc/run_drc.py --check` fail outright:
the probe cell stops reporting `clean` (`uncovered_layer_probe` is
then a positive DRC catch, not a documented gap) -- reproduced by
installing `main` (`f03a90c` at the time) during this bring-up and
watching `run_drc.py --check` report real violations against a
manifest that still expects `clean`. That is exactly the outcome
`layout/README.md`'s own negative-control section calls 'the useful
failure: it tells us the gap closed' -- but re-baselining #15's
already-merged record for that closure is a distinct piece of work,
out of scope for #51 (LVS bring-up only), so this pin deliberately
sits in the commit window where both bring-ups' assertions hold at
once: at or after `e08f24f` (`extract`+`lvs` exist) and strictly
before `1d5fc60` (DRC coverage still matches #15's manifest).
`e08f24f` itself -- the commit that landed `lvs` -- is the pin: the
earliest point satisfying the first bound, verified against both
runners' `--check` before being recorded here. A future bump past
`1d5fc60` needs `layout/drc/cells/cells.json`'s `uncovered_layer_probe`
expectations re-baselined in the same change, not silently left stale.
klt_install            exact commit to install `klt` from -- a `pip`/
`uv tool install` VCS URL pinned with `@<sha>`
(no PyPI release yet, ../README.md), not a
floating branch reference. See above for why
floating is unsafe for this repo specifically.
klt_required_commands  every `klt <command>` this repo's layout/
runners invoke. A missing one is a tooling
error (exit 1), not a silently-skipped check.
klt_last_verified_commit  the exact commit `klt_install` resolves to,
restated here so it is visible without
parsing the install URL. Update both together
and re-run both runners' --check when bumping
-- and re-baseline `layout/drc/cells/
cells.json` first if the new commit is at or
after `1d5fc60` (see above).
klayout_package_min    floor for the pip `klayout` package version
(`klayout_tools`' own `pyproject.toml` pins
`klayout>=0.29`); recorded here so a drift in
*this* repo's pin is visible next to `klt`'s.
A drift in `klt_required_commands` is fatal by default; there is no
--allow-toolchain-drift override here (unlike sim/toolchain.json) --
layout/ evidence is cheap enough to regenerate that skipping the check
has no use case yet.
